name: linggen
description: Linggen for Claude Code — one local program, one address: durable cross-host memory (MCP server `memory`, /mcp/memory) and browser control in your own Chrome, logged-in X reads and agents (MCP server `linggen`, /mcp), both from the Linggen engine. Per-turn memory recall built in, and /linggen:config points this host at a Linggen on another machine. Installs Linggen (background download) on first session start.
